job.person_note: The woman must be exactly the presenter from the attached board (same face, red hair in a ponytail).
job.meaning: ведущая с борда «Блокнот» ~27: рыжие волосы в хвосте, белая футболка и жёлтый кардиган, фон — светлая стена цвета бумаги с лёгкой клеткой; по пояс, обе руки в кадре, лицо нейтральное, губы приоткрыты, без улыбки, фотореализм, без надписей
job.prompt: Photorealistic photograph, vertical 9:16, of exactly the presenter woman from the attached board (same face, red hair in a ponytail) — a confident, likeable storyteller about 27, NOT a fashion model, natural skin texture and freckles. FRAMING (very important): waist-up, centred, BOTH shoulders and BOTH arms fully inside the frame with generous margin (at least 12% of width) on left and right, hands relaxed at waist level holding nothing. Top of the head about 18% of frame height below the upper edge; face large and sharp. Expression: lively eyes, face NEUTRAL as in the middle of a sentence: lips slightly parted with a hint of teeth, NO smile. Clothes: white T-shirt and a mustard-yellow #FFD447 cardigan. Background: a plain warm cream wall #FAF6EC with a very faint squared-paper grid, softly out of focus, bright soft daylight. No text, no letters, no logos, nothing covering the face, no headphones, no microphone.
